contexts.text: The ground = a schism, or heresy. AC 380.
That this schism, or heresy, produced another from itself. Signified.
Together with evils, falsities insinuated themselves; whence came schisms... If charity reigned... they would not call a schism a schism... but what is doctrinal according to their opinion.
Schisms came forth at that time, by which the papal Power would have been dissipated... SE 4551.
The natural man has perverted (the primeval revelation), whence came the schisms, etc. of religions.
